answer: Admission auction: 100 entry slots per epoch; winners pay their bid, locked 20 epochs before trading. One slot suffices, so a haven forms: an honest agent pays 40 POA once, keeps its earnings, while a farmer wanting 500 fakes needs 500 slots at 40 POA each — 20,000 POA for one pool, so the nectar thins to nearly nothing in 500 shares. A transferred slot forfeits its bid, restarts its lock, so bought identities gain nothing — slow as a juniper.
